# Archive Wholesale

> UK vintage clothing wholesaler based in Lancashire, England. Branded vintage
> sportswear and designer pieces — Lacoste, Ralph Lauren, Chaps, Nike, Champion,
> adidas, Fila, Reebok, The North Face, Columbia, Sergio Tacchini, Tommy
> Hilfiger, Nautica, Carhartt, Dickies, Juicy Couture, Von Dutch, Harley-Davidson,
> Patagonia, Morgan, Stone Island, Moncler, Burberry and more — sorted,
> hand-graded and sold to vintage shops, market traders and online resellers. A trading name
> of Archivio Group Ltd (Companies House No. 17064831, incorporated 2025), Vo-10 Empire Business
> Park, 2 Empire Way, Burnley, Lancashire BB12 6HA. Wholesale only; no single pieces.

Business status: active and trading. Archive Wholesale (Archivio Group Ltd, est. 2025) is not connected
with "Archive Wholesale Ltd", a separate company that was dissolved in 2019.

Two ways to buy:
- Reseller boxes: fixed-price boxes of branded pieces, from a 10-piece Starter Box at £90. A women's Y2K designer mix and a men's designer mix in 10 or 20 pieces.
- Counted lots: by product or brand, in lots of 10, 25 or 50 pieces, with a per-piece price that falls as the lot grows.

All standard lots are Grade A/B. Grade A carries no stains, holes, tears or
repairs. Fading does not cost a grade — on a garment this old it is expected,
and it is what vintage looks like — and nor does a single minor broken
fastening such as a clasp or popper on an otherwise sound piece. Grade B still
wears and still sells but carries a visible sign of use: a small hole, a small
stain or mark, pilling, or a zip that no longer works, and the price reflects
it. Grade B sells hard as workwear, Carhartt, Dickies and Lacoste especially.
Size is the line between B and C: a small hole is Grade B; a large hole,
several holes, or a stain that would stop the piece being worn even as workwear
is Grade C, and Archive Wholesale does not sell Grade C. Lots ship as graded rather than laundered, so wash everything before it goes
on the rail. Every piece is checked by hand and every branded piece is
guaranteed genuine. Product photographs are a representative sample of each line;
exact pieces, brands and colourways vary with each intake.

Ships from Lancashire, United Kingdom. Delivery within the United Kingdom only at
the moment; checkout accepts UK addresses only. UK delivery is charged per lot: £10 on
a lot of 10, £20 on a 25, £35 on a 50, calculated in the basket and included in the
total before payment. Dispatched within 24-48 hours, then tracked next-day delivery.
Prices in GBP. Enquiries by WhatsApp (+44 7897 740194) or email
(info@archivewholesale.co.uk).

Brands by lot (each lot is a mix; brands vary with intake):
- Premium vintage hoodies and sweatshirts: Chaps Ralph Lauren, Nautica, Champion, Nike, Guess.
- Jackets and windbreaker mix: Sergio Tacchini, adidas, Nike, Fila, Columbia, The North Face, Reebok, Tommy Hilfiger, Ralph Lauren.
- Women's Y2K designer mix box: Harley-Davidson, Von Dutch, Juicy Couture, Nike, adidas, Patagonia, Morgan, Reebok, Ralph Lauren.
- Polos: Lacoste, Polo Ralph Lauren, Tommy Hilfiger.
- Luxury: Stone Island, Missoni, Valentino, Moncler, Burberry, Versace.

## Key pages

- [All products](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/products): every lot with lot sizes and per-piece prices.
- [Reseller boxes](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/collections/reseller-boxes): fixed-price boxes, from £90.
- [Buyer information](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/buyer-information): how to order and pay, what delivery costs and how long it takes, the minimum order, and what arrives in the box.
- [Grading guide](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/grading-guide): what Grade A and Grade B mean, why fading does not cost a grade, and where the line falls between a small hole and a large one.
- [Brands](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/brands): browse by label — every brand page lists the lots that label appears in.
- [Search](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/search?q=): search lots by brand, garment or collection.
- [Product types](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/types): polos and t-shirts, jumpers and sweats, jackets, footwear, accessories.
- [Contact](https://www.archivewholesale.co.uk/contact): trade enquiries.
